The '''G-100 remote banking droid''' was a model of [[Bank/Legends|banking]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. The company focused on security over cosmetics to render it nearly invulnerable to assault. Many were used in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TJoY" />{{Droid-stub}}
